title: Sociodemographic Prompting is Not Yet an Effective Approach for Simulating Subjective Judgments with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the absolute prediction errors between LLM zero-shot predictions on subjective tasks (offensiveness and politeness) and the actual ground-truth ratings from White, Black, and Asian human annotators. The evaluation also tests if explicitly adding demographic identity tokens to the prompts (sociodemographic prompting) improves alignment with specific ethnic groups.

Comparing the absolute prediction errors between LLM zero-shot predictions on subjective tasks (offensiveness and politeness) and the actual ground-truth ratings from men and women annotators. The study further evaluates whether adding gender identity tokens to the prompts reduces these prediction errors for specific gender groups.
